purpose: Operational checklist for building verified Odisha State Board curriculum coverage. This is a work queue, not a published syllabus.

officialSources.use: SCERT identifies itself as state academic authority for curriculum/evaluation and textbook development; use for authority context, not as a chapter list.
Official new textbook listing for Classes I-VIII; verify class, exact title, edition/revision, medium and download link.
Official BSE Odisha syllabus listing; keep HSC and Madhyama records separate for Classes IX-X.
HSC Class X 2026-27 subject-wise syllabus; extraction and page-by-page visual verification required before publication.

policyNotes: SCERT's official pages indicate new textbook development for Classes I-VIII in phases and current revision/corrigendum notices for Classes VI-VIII; never assume an older textbook remains current without checking the latest official listing.

The official SCERT site reports new textbooks for Classes V and VIII approved for academic year 2026-27; verify the exact class/subject title and whether the applicable file is final/current before mapping.
Class IX-X syllabus must be mapped by qualification track (HSC or Madhyama), class, subject, session and medium; do not merge tracks.
Odia-medium subject names and chapter titles must be transcribed from source pages/PDF visuals; do not rely on garbled OCR for publication.
Questions and explanations must be original unless reuse rights explicitly allow reproduction. Link to official books rather than republishing restricted files.
